fullPassage: Religious beliefs do have some major positive effects. For example, many people that run charities helping the poor and disadvantaged are motivated by their religious outlook. It is also obvious that such beliefs have inspired and stimulated many forms of art, especially painting, sculpture, architecture and music. You have only to look up at the Sistine Chapel ceiling in St. Peter's in Rome or listen to the King's College Choir in Cambridge to realise this. Science has not inspired art to anything like the same extent, but in my personal view, what science is doing is revealing a Universe whose complexity and beauty surpasses anything imagined by supernaturalists. To appreciate this, look at the breathtaking photographs taken by the Hubble Space Telescope. On the other hand, science lacks for some, but by no means all, people, the same emotional appeal as religion - it presents a view of human life that is bleak and joyless by comparison, because of the absence of any discernable, overall purpose in the Universe. This view conflicts with the purpose-driven, individual lives that we all lead. This relative lack of appeal is probably the main reason why the majority of people confine their interest in science to its useful applications or dangers, and turn to religion to seek meaning and comfort, especially in times of grief and hardship. Belief in the supernatural provides the possibility of hope in circumstances where a naturalistic approach might provide none. As the poet T.S. Eliot wrote, "Humankind cannot bear very much reality."

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

Religious beliefs do have some major positive effects. For example, many people that run charities helping the poor and disadvantaged are motivated by their religious outlook.

(A) Science has not inspired art to anything like the same extent, but in my personal view, what science is doing is revealing a Universe whose complexity and beauty surpasses anything imagined by supernaturalists. To appreciate this, look at the breathtaking photographs taken by the Hubble Space Telescope.

(B) It is also obvious that such beliefs have inspired and stimulated many forms of art, especially painting, sculpture, architecture and music. You have only to look up at the Sistine Chapel ceiling in St. Peter's in Rome or listen to the King's College Choir in Cambridge to realise this.

(C) On the other hand, science lacks for some, but by no means all, people, the same emotional appeal as religion - it presents a view of human life that is bleak and joyless by comparison, because of the absence of any discernable, overall purpose in the Universe. This view conflicts with the purpose-driven, individual lives that we all lead.

det.korean: 종교와 과학이 각각 주는 의미와 위안의 대비 — 종교는 예술에 영감을 주었고, 과학은 예술에는 그만큼 영감을 주지 못했지만 우주의 아름다움을 드러내며, 정서적 호소력은 종교보다 약하다는 전개이다.
det.analysis:
① (A) - (B) - (C)
→ (A)는 "Science has not inspired art to anything like the same extent"로 시작하여 앞서 '종교가 예술에 영감을 주었다'는 내용이 먼저 언급되어야 함. 도입문 직후에 올 수 없음

② (B) - (A) - (C) ← 정답
→ 도입문: 종교적 신념의 긍정적 효과(자선) 언급 → (B): 그런 신념이 예술(그림·조각·건축·음악)에 영감을 주었다는 구체적 예시(시스티나 성당, 킹스 칼리지 합창단) → (A): "Science has not inspired art to the same extent, but..."로 과학과의 대비 시작, 허블 망원경 사진 언급 → (C): "On the other hand"로 전환, 과학이 정서적 호소력은 부족하다는 내용과 그 이유

③ (C) - (A) - (B)
→ (C)의 "On the other hand"는 앞에 과학의 긍정적 측면(우주의 아름다움)이 먼저 와야 자연스러운데, 도입문만으로는 전환 근거 부족

④ (A) - (C) - (B)
→ (A)가 먼저 오면 '예술에 영감을 준 종교' 언급이 빠진 채 과학과 비교하는 문장이 와서 비교 대상이 불명확해짐
det.tip: On the other hand(반면에)는 앞의 내용(과학이 우주의 아름다움을 드러낸다는 긍정적 내용)과 대비되는 전환어이다.

③ ( ③ ) 뒤: 허블 망원경 사진 언급 직후. 과학의 아름다움에 관한 내용이라 '예술적 성취'와 무관

questions.passage: Religious beliefs do have some major positive effects. For example, many people that run charities helping the poor and disadvantaged are motivated by their religious outlook. It is also obvious that such beliefs have inspired and stimulated many forms of art, especially painting, sculpture, architecture and music. You have only to look up at the Sistine Chapel ceiling in St. Peter's in Rome or listen to the King's College Choir in Cambridge to realise this. Science has not inspired art to anything like the same extent, but in my personal view, what science is doing is revealing a Universe whose complexity and beauty surpasses anything imagined by supernaturalists. To appreciate this, look at the breathtaking photographs taken by the Hubble Space Telescope. On the other hand, science lacks for some, but by no means all, people, the same emotional appeal as religion - it presents a view of human life that is bleak and joyless by comparison, because of the absence of any discernable, overall purpose in the Universe. This view conflicts with the purpose-driven, individual lives that we all lead. This relative lack of appeal is probably the main reason why the majority of people confine their interest in science to its useful applications or dangers, and __________, especially in times of grief and hardship. Belief in the supernatural provides the possibility of hope in circumstances where a naturalistic approach might provide none. As the poet T.S. Eliot wrote, "Humankind cannot bear very much reality."

"그들은 의미와 위안을 찾기 위해 종교에 의지한다."

[조건] (1) and, comfort, meaning, religion, seek, to, to, turn을 모두 사용
       (2) 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: 그들은 의미와 위안을 찾기 위해 종교에 의지한다.
det.analysis: turn to religion(동사+전치사구, ~에 의지하다) + to seek meaning and comfort(목적을 나타내는 to부정사구) → turn to religion to seek meaning and comfort (8단어)
det.tip: turn to A to V: V하기 위해 A에 의지하다

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 주어 many people이 종교적 신념에 '의해 동기를 부여받는' 것이므로 motivate를 수동형 과거분사 motivated로 바꿔야 한다.
det.analysis: are __________ (motivate) by their religious outlook → 「be + p.p. + by」 수동태 구조이므로 motivate → motivated(과거분사)
det.tip: be + p.p. + by: motivate → motivated

det.korean: 과학이 '지금 하고 있는 일'이 우주를 드러내는 것이라는 진행 중인 의미를 나타내므로 reveal을 현재분사 revealing으로 바꿔야 한다.
